name: eurobase
description: Deploy GitHub repositories to Eurobase and inspect deployments, logs and usage. Every deploy waits for your approval in Eurobase.

interface.longDescription: Eurobase builds and runs your apps from GitHub on European infrastructure. Publish a repository as a new project, deploy, redeploy or roll back, and read deployments, logs, diagnoses and usage for the projects you choose. Every deployment and new project waits for your approval on a Eurobase confirmation page, and secret values never reach the assistant.
defaultPrompt: Deploy this GitHub repository on Eurobase as a new project.
Why did the latest deployment of my Eurobase project fail?
